annotations.title: Watch the total price of a product

description: Creates (or resets) the signed-in person's watch of one product (one per product). Fordeal mails the person when the recommended total for `deliver_to_country` (goods + shipping, same meaning as on the website) falls under `target_total`, never twice for one price and at most once a day. Without `target_total` the target is today's total: the mail comes when the price really drops (by the currency's step, e.g. 50 CZK). Today's total is stored as saved_total. Needs the person's access token. Answers the watch as list_my_price_watches shows it.

deliver_to_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "CZ". Optional: normally derived from the address.

locale.description: Language of the alert mails. Default: the person's, then the country's.

target_total.description: Mail when the total falls to or under this amount, in the currency of deliver_to_country. Default: today's total.

name: set_price_watch
